name: security-payout-beneficiary-lifecycle-review
intent: Payout beneficiary changes and confirmation-to-execution binding
artifacts: Beneficiary registration/verification, cooldown/approval policy, payout queue and final destination selection.
trace: Trace which beneficiary version was approved and which version the queued payout resolves, especially edits after confirmation.
experiment: Use a sandbox beneficiary fixture with synthetic destinations; compare approved payout with a post-approval destination change.
disproof: An edited display label is not changed funds routing; show the effective destination used by the sandbox execution.
repair: Bind payout approval to immutable beneficiary intent and retest allowed updates, cooldown and execution.
branch_decisions: Determine whether confirmation approves a beneficiary identity or an immutable beneficiary version. A queued payout resolving a later changed destination can violate a version-bound approval. A label change with the same account identifier is not altered routing; verify the actual sandbox destination.
